description: This file defines the Cryptographer class in the OrangeHRM Core Utility namespace, providing encryption and decryption functionalities using AES and Rijndael algorithms based on a given key.

classes.name: Cryptographer
classes.description: Provides methods to encrypt and decrypt data using AES and Rijndael encryption algorithms.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Cryptographer with a specified key.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts a string value using Rijndael algorithm and returns a hexadecimal string in uppercase.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted hexadecimal string back to plain text.

methods.name: generateKey
methods.description: Generates an encryption key based on the input key, applying XOR across key bytes.
